infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Sportify reads your sleep and step data from Apple Health so your dashboard shows real figures instead of asking you to type them in.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Sportify saves the workouts you finish here to Apple Health, so they count towards your activity rings alongside everything else you do.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Sportify uses the camera to photograph a meal so it can estimate the calories and macros for you.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Sportify lets you pick a photo of a meal from your library, and set a cover image on your own workouts.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Sportify reads your step count from the phone's motion sensor to fill in your daily activity.
